task_intent: Redesign Tessera settings and everyday interactions with expressive wall feedback and clear native navigation.

sources.title: Perplexity · prompt composer
sources.applied: One generously sized composer with its primary send action in place; useful contextual prompts sit adjacent to entry.

sources.title: WhatsApp · Ask Meta AI
sources.applied: A calm entry state with a distinct visual identity and optional suggestions, adapted to Tessera's pixel vocabulary rather than copied.

sources.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines · Text fields
sources.applied: Persistent label, multiline question entry, accessible Clear control, and no premature keyboard focus.

sources.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines · Progress indicators
sources.applied: Use indeterminate progress for an answer with an unknown completion time; clearly state that leaving the page is allowed.

sources.title: Anthropic Python SDK · bounded requests
sources.applied: Bound the full question to a 75-second window using per-request timeout, with automatic retries disabled so paid requests are not repeated invisibly after the phone timeout.

sources.title: Apple AVSpeechSynthesizer · system-managed audio session
sources.applied: Read aloud is an explicit action. Its separate system-managed audio session preserves video playback configuration, and speech stops when leaving Ask or backgrounding the app.

sources.title: WhatsApp · text status composition
sources.applied: Prioritize the actual message as the main canvas; keep the send action beside composition rather than in a second configuration popup.

sources.title: ID · message editing
sources.applied: Keep a visible preview while editing, with compact contextual choices. Tessera uses the exact wall-produced pixels instead of a decorative substitute.

sources.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines · Feedback
sources.applied: Confirm the wall's acknowledgement inline and separate draft state from a live note; show recovery text without an interrupting alert.

sources.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines · Writing
sources.applied: Use direct actions such as Take down and Replace the current note, with concise explanation of expiry and return behavior.
